scenes.title: 12 Snow Friends Characters
tips: Give each friend a silly voice
scenes.say: Give every character a silly voice when it flips. Little ones remember the funny ones fastest.

scenes.title: 12 Arctic Animals
scenes.say: Make each animal's sound before you match it. No reading needed, so everyone can join in.

scenes.title: 12 Winter Vocab Cards
tips: Read the word on every flip
scenes.say: Read the word out loud on every flip. Early readers pick up winter vocabulary without trying.

scenes.title: 12 Snowman Workshop Cards
scenes.say: Chunky cut lines make this a great one for kids to snip out themselves before playing.

scenes.title: 12 Winter Transport Cards
scenes.say: Older kids can say where each vehicle is headed. It keeps longer rounds interesting.

scenes.title: 12 Winter Clothing & Gear
tips: Find the real item at home
scenes.say: Play it while getting bundled up, then hunt for the real mittens and boots by the door.

scenes.title: 12 Cozy Cabin & Snowy Woods
scenes.say: Color both copies the same way with the kids, so their artwork becomes the game.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Print each page twice to make pairs
Most sets come in color and B&W
tips.say: Print each page twice to make pairs, and pick the black and white version to save ink.

say.title: Free printable winter memory games for cozy snow days.
say.hook: Print twice, cut, and start flipping.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
